explanation: Nicéphore Niépce captured the view from his window in France in 1826 or 1827, on a pewter plate. Britain issued the Penny Black, the first adhesive stamp, in May 1840.
learnMore: View from the Window at Le Gras

claims.text: The oldest surviving photograph taken with a camera, Nicéphore Niépce's view from his window at Le Gras, was made in 1826 or 1827.
The Penny Black, the first adhesive postage stamp, was issued in Britain in May 1840.
Niépce's photograph was made on a pewter plate.
